tools.name: normalize_token_snapshot
tools.description: Gate 1: Normalize Solana DexScreener + RugCheck feeds into unified SOL-denominated metrics and strict liquidity status (As-Is telemetry only).

tools.name: check_token_structure
tools.description: Gate 2: Inspect Solana SPL/Token-2022 structural flags, authority risk, LP lock %, Top10 concentration, Sybil dispersion, and liquidity collapse (As-Is telemetry only).

tools.name: detect_flow_anomaly
tools.description: Gate 3: Compute objective 5m/1h order flow ratios, panic selling flags, average trade size ($30 micro-bot threshold), and wash turnover ratio (As-Is telemetry only).

tools.name: evaluate_market_timing
tools.description: Gate 4: Report JST liquidity drought window, optional Solana pool age stage, Fear & Greed index, Binance Vision spot prices, and bitbank JPY parity basis (As-Is telemetry only).

tools.name: get_composite_gate_report
tools.description: Gate 5: Execute all 4 objective gates in one consolidated structured report for AI agents and research pipelines (As-Is telemetry only, not financial advice).
